description: ACT Government publishes this point inventory of municipal assets in the Australian Capital Territory. The asset subtypes are stand pipes and taps. The provider describes attributes for material, quantity, make and model, height and asset subtype. Assets are captured through works-as-executed handover or field audits. Coverage is limited to assets owned or managed by the named ACT government services; private, federal and other directorate assets may be absent. The Socrata catalogue and JSON view metadata are public and free to inspect. Native metadata identifies the licence as CC BY 4.0. Caveats: only metadata was inspected, no dataset rows or geometry values were downloaded. Field definitions do not establish field completeness or current asset condition. For infrastructure simulation, the inventory can locate terminal fittings in municipal water-service models; flow or demand values are not established. Related catalogue: ACT Government open data portal.
